units.source_text: 那裡可是酒池肉林……」「是咖啡酒吧嗎？」「是的。」「走吧！」

en.t: That place is a den of drink and women... "A cafe bar?" "Yes." "Let's go!"

units.source_text: 兩個人坐上了市營電車，堀木開心地嚷嚷：「我今晚對女人特別飢渴，可以親吻女服務員嗎？」

en.t: The two of us boarded a municipal streetcar, and Horiki shouted happily, "Tonight I am absolutely starved for women. May I kiss the waitress?"

units.source_text: 我不太喜歡堀木演示的這種醉態，堀木也知道這一點。

en.t: I did not much like Horiki putting on that kind of drunken display, and Horiki knew that too.

units.source_text: 所以他又特意補充道：「可以嗎？親吻啦，我要親吻坐我旁邊的女服務員給你看。可以啊？」

en.t: So he deliberately added, "All right? I mean a kiss. I am going to kiss the waitress who sits beside me and show you. Is that all right?"

units.source_text: 「沒問題吧。」「謝謝啊，我真的對女人很飢渴呢。」

en.t: "I suppose that is fine." "Thanks. I really am starved for women."
